steps.title: Define Project Specifications
steps.description: Establish the exact Java 8 compatible layout and design, targeted for Android SDK 34 using Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Configure the workspace package structure as com.notesapp.app and app name to Notes Manager.

steps.title: Establish Build Definitions
steps.description: Configure compilation and SDK bounds via app/build.gradle targeting standard compilation without non-SDK libraries.

steps.title: Configure Manifest Layout
steps.description: Create AndroidManifest.xml referencing MainActivity and setting up proper application launcher traits and theme.

steps.title: Establish Storage Architecture
steps.description: Design DatabaseHelper.java to manage the notes table, categories table, default values, and standard CRUD SQLite queries.

steps.title: Create User Interface Drawables
steps.description: Create xml layout shapes like rounded inputs, action-button layouts, category list cell styles, and custom card backgrounds.

steps.title: Design Main Screen Layout
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml including a top title banner, a text search query box, a category selection filter spinner, and a full size ListView.

steps.title: Design List Item Interface Layouts
steps.description: Formulate beautiful note_item.xml layouts with interactive inline editing and deleting configurations, complete with category indicators.

steps.title: Create Editor & Management Layouts
steps.description: Construct modal layouts dialog_note.xml and dialog_categories.xml to edit detailed notes and manage categories in runtime lists.

steps.title: Develop Main System Controller
steps.description: Implement MainActivity.java with fully custom note item adapters, dynamic search query filtration, category sorting filters, dialog managers, and database callbacks.

steps.title: Validate Core Functionality
steps.description: Ensure perfect compile bounds, check for Android XML namespace validity, test lifecycle actions, and clear residual memory.

steps.title: Building Notes Manager
steps.description: Initiate automated build generation for the Notes Manager APK targeting Android API Level 34.
